title: Telemetry-driven kernel prober and regression-hunting pipeline for FlashAttention v2/v3
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: implement a telemetry-driven kernel probing and selection pipeline that safely explores FlashAttention v2/v3 variants at runtime, collects per-workload signals, and surfaces regressions early. This ticket covers design, lightweight runtime prober, metric schema, canary rollout plan, and temporary rollback/guardrails to avoid customer-facing latency regressions. Motivation: recent v3-prefill jitter in long-context decode traces and a few customer regression reports require a structured exploration + quick rollback flow so we can adopt v3's perf wins without increasing incidents. Deliverables: (1) runtime prober module that probabilistically routes a small fraction of prefill/decode requests to alternate kernels (v2/v3/quantized variants), (2) new telemetry events and aggregation keys (fingerprint, seq_len_bucket, prompt_prefix_hash, batch_size, hot_kv_hit_rate), (3) evaluation dashboard and alerting rules for latency delta, p99 increase, token error-rate delta, and quality diffs, (4) canary rollout automation and a safety circuit that throttles exploration when regression thresholds tripped.
comments: 2025-02-14 - Aisha: Initial problem statement and proposed approach posted. Spoke with Research about quality risk; they recommended green/amber/red thresholds tied to eval prompt set.

2025-02-15 - Marco: Implemented a minimal runtime hook (kernel_prober) that accepts a seed and exploration rate (%) and forks a single copy of prefill to run on the candidate kernel for instrumentation only. Hook is gated behind feature-flag 'kernel-prober-experimental'.

2025-02-16 - Marco: Benchmarks on devbox (A100 80GB) with llama-13b; baseline v2 prefill p50=18ms token, v3 candidate p50=14ms token for short contexts, but for long contexts (>4096) observed p99 regressions up to +22% in a microtrace; added seq_len_bucket telemetry.

2025-02-17 - Priya (Research): Ran small golden prompt set against candidate variant; no measurable quality divergence on our baseline evals for the probed prompts. Recommended adding a fuzzed prompt subset to catch numerical instability in quantized combos.

2025-02-18 - Marco: Pushed PR to add telemetry schema and StatsD tags: kernel_variant, fingerprint_hash, seq_len_bucket, batch_count, kv_cache_hits, exploratory_group. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6821. Requesting eng review from @Sasha and @Liu.

2025-02-19 - Sasha (Eng lead): Reviewed PR, requested that exploratory sampling be capped per-customer to 0.5% and globally to 2% initially. Also asked for a fast rollback circuit that disables probes for a kernel if p99 latency delta > 10ms for 5m window. Marco to implement.

2025-02-20 - Marco: Canary plan drafted. Steps: enable prober in staging for 48h with synthetic workload matrix; roll to 1% of production for non-SLA customers; monitor dashboard (runtime-kernel-prober) and alert on p99_delta>10ms or incidence of errors. Linked docs: Confluence design: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUNTIME/Kernel+Prober+Design, Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/xyz/runtime-kernel-prober. Added follow-up: investigate the long-context p99 spike root cause (ENG-905433).
